summary.name: Building Successful SRE in Large Enterprises
summary.one_liner: A Google Drive-hosted PDF slide deck from a Velocity NYC talk by Dave Rensin and Liz Fong-Jones on building site reliability engineering (SRE) practices in large enterprises.
use_cases: learning how to introduce SRE into a large organization
reading conference talk slides on reliability
summary.what_it_does: The page is a 35-slide PDF presentation hosted on Google Drive, titled Building Successful SRE in Large Enterprises, given at Velocity (NYC) by Dave Rensin and Liz Fong-Jones. The visible portion covers only the first four slides: the title slide, the statement that reliability is the most important feature, the point that users measure a service's reliability, and the question of how to improve reliability through DevOps or SRE. The rest of the deck is not included in the page text, so its specific recommendations cannot be confirmed from this page.
notable: Presented by Google staff: Dave Rensin (Customer Reliability Engineering) and Liz Fong-Jones (Staff Developer Advocate for SRE)
Part of the awesome-sre list under the Culture section
